verses.mystical_translation: What human labor completes finds rest when the consecrated goods of memory enter the sacred storehouse.
Leaders gather to lift the ark—memory and covenant carried into the renewed center.
In the seventh month the nation gathers; liturgy times the movement of the ark.
Elders arrive; Levites bear the ark—burden and office intertwined.
The portable sanctuary and its implements are lifted—mobile holiness becomes stationary.
Irrecountable offerings crowd the threshold where the ark stands.
The ark rests under winged figures; the oracle receives the covenant.
Wings spread protect and hide; the sacred carriage is enfolded above.
Handles half-revealed: instruments visible within the sanctuary, hidden to the outside.
Only the two tablets dwell inside—covenant-stones from the desert meeting.
The sanctuary's ministers stand sanctified together; usual rotations suspended in consecration.
A chorus of Levites and priests, instrument and voice as a single body, forms the liturgical frame.
Unified song summons presence; the people's praise manifests as a cloud, the dwelling filled.
The cloud disables the ministers; glory fills the space and dissolves ordinary service.

contemplative_note: The people's unified praise makes space for the divine presence; attention to communal liturgy as locus of encounter.
safety_note: Contains large-scale ritual slaughter and cultic violence imagery; preserved as in source.
